items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Finally, Kimberl started playing banjo. And Kimberl took up a lot of time with me.

ctx.x: something we had to want to work with.

Yeah. And, well, Kimberl, his daddy used to play with Celestan, the original Celestan, used to play bass. Finally, Kimberl started playing banjo. And Kimberl took up a lot of time with me. Do you understand? Did you know
about Kimberl's daddy playing bass? Yeah,
